summary: A conversion-focused niche landing page for real estate agents who need instant follow-up, accurate listings, and zero-friction scheduling. Super positions itself as a sharper, cheaper-for-repetition alternative to chat-style assistants by operating real software and reusing a computer-use cache for durable workflows.
